title: VVC smoke: random access, dual-tree I picture, LMCS (176x144)
note: Synthetic ffmpeg testsrc2 encoded with VTM-24.0 EncoderApp (random-access cfg, QP 37). Analyzed from the unmodified VTM decoder's traces. Pixel stages available: before loop filters (luma inverse-mapped by LMCS) and output; VTM does not trace prediction samples.

note: Synthetic rotating testsrc2 encoded with VTM-24.0 (low-delay B cfg, QP 32): affine and subblock merge, geometric partitioning, MMVD, CIIP, local dual-tree chroma blocks.

title: HEVC smoke: random access, AMP, SAO, transform skip (176x144)
note: Synthetic ffmpeg testsrc2 encoded with HM (random-access cfg, QP 32). Analyzed by linking the unmodified HM decoder library; per-CU bits come from hook calls in a copy of HM. Pixel stages: before loop filters and output.

title: VP9 2x2 tiles, error resilient (512x288)
note: Synthetic ffmpeg testsrc2 encoded with libvpx v1.17.0 vpxenc (2-pass good, cq 32, 2x2 tiles, error resilient and frame parallel mode). Pixel stages: prediction, before loop filter, output.

title: AVC smoke: High profile CABAC, I/P/B, 8x8 transform (176x144)
note: Synthetic ffmpeg testsrc2 encoded with the JM 19.1 reference encoder (High profile, two B pictures, spatial direct). Analyzed by linking the unmodified JM decoder. Pixel stages: prediction, before deblocking, output.

title: AV2 diff: reference vs a simulated C-model bug (176x144)
note: A = the AV2 smoke stream decoded by AVM v1.0.0. B = the same analysis with a 4x4 luma defect (+2) injected before the loop filters at (40, 24) of decode frame 3 (vca mutate), standing in for a residual-path bug in a C model. The page opens on the first mismatch.
